contexts.text: As the work of a sapphire () = what is translucid there from internal truths, and all things from the Lord; (for) the work of a sapphire = the quality of the literal sense of the Word when the internal sense is apperceived in it... AE 329:7. AE 701:11.
Truth Divine translucent in the ultimate of order, which is the Word in the letter, is especially signified by a sapphire. Illustrated.
(Thus) a sapphire = truth in ultimates translucent from internal truths.
A sapphire stone () = truth translucent from internal truths; a stone = truth; and sapphire, translucence.

A chrysoprase, a sapphire, and a diamond () = the celestial love of truth, from which are what follow... The stones of this row partake of a blue which is from red... which sparkles inwardly from what is flamy; and it is this blue which = the celestial love of truth.

The sapphire... is of an azure colour, such as is that of the sky... and therefore it is said... there was under His feet like the work of a sapphire, and like the substance of heaven for cleanness (). This stone = what is translucid from interior truths, which are the truths of celestial love.

The sapphire, in a general sense, = the external of the Celestial Kingdom... and therefore it was the middle stone in the second row; (for) the stones of the second row = the external good of the Celestial kingdom, which is called the celestial love of truth, (and the middle involves the whole. AC 9873:7.)
That the sapphire = the external of the Celestial Kingdom. Illustrated.
The councillors... wore cut sapphires, pendant from their necks...
Each (successively) put on... a hat, upon the crown of which was a rosary girt about with small sapphires.
Clad in cloaks of a sapphirine colour.
The sapphire (in the Word) = spiritual good, which is the good of the Middle Heaven.
A sapphire = what is translucid from truths. References.

The reason the throne appeared in the aspect of a sapphire stone () was that a sapphire = the Divine truth proceeding from His Divine good, and, thence, spiritual truth pellucent from celestial good...
By sapphires, carbuncles, rabies, etc. are signified such truths as are in the sense of the letter, which are ultimate, because for the natural and sensuous man.
The work of a sapphire stone under His feet () = Divine truth in ultimates, such as is the Word in the letter... A sapphire = what is translucid from internal truths.
